status: Offline candidate only; weapon roles partially satisfied; equal-ship 120-240 seconds NOT established.
weapon_assumptions: V4 proposal, NOT production kinetic behavior. Production launch speed, thermal and guard methods; analytical energy/impulse law in shared offline model; stationary normal incidence unless angle explicitly scanned; all old C/M combinations retained. V3 sustained DPS anchors, medium rapid cooling compensation 85/340. Full supply; no new laser heat.
hull_assumptions: PROPOSED energy/impulse/fragmentation in shared offline model; production penetration, guard state and native building damage. Eight independent armor/device lanes, NOT a complete two-sided ship battle. Defenses always two devices: GG=2 guards; KG=1 kinetic+1 guard; EG=1 EM+1 guard. Pulse reserve only, no grid routing/generation/idle/recovery draw simulated. Weapon supply unlimited; energy spent recorded, not a firing gate. Constant 100-cell flight delay and projectile lifetime, no movement/aiming/return hits/fragment scatter/structural breakup/repair. Reflected packets leave target; recorded return budget is potential, not actual friendly damage. Fragments are collinear, a concentrated-hit stress case. First line failure is first underfunded interception, not shield HP depletion. Half-device destruction is not ship defeat. 1e9 pulse reserve is a practically-unlimited diagnostic.
